contract.budget_normalization: Calibrated to frozen reference drift, actual budgets can differ and are measured.
contract.density_ratio: Descriptive explicit local feature proxy, not future-success probability.
contract.dose: Post-RMS actual displacement; common reward scaling can cancel.
contract.feature_profile: Online feature moments are linearly interpolated saved rows. Whole-window quadratic fits and derivatives are diagnostic, not the online control curve. Post-RMS historical contrast attenuation measures standardized descriptive separation, not calibrated reliability or future success.

local_support_selection.rule: Atom count is an upper bound from molecule coverage, never a target. Query and cite the selected region local_support_evidence; compare local contrast beyond whole-cloud similarity. Teacher trends are not cohort enrichment. Explain why every included neighbor is needed; broad historical support is a baseline, not an automatically inherited hypothesis.

contract.measurement_stages: Nonzero component VJP establishes activation only, not geometric/elemental formation. Formation uses actual boundary geometry/layout. Retention compares boundary and terminal layout of the same tracked support after the unguided suffix. Zero clipping and constant dose during control are NOT suffix-retention evidence. Nonzero raw component gradient does not establish a significant change in the normalized total direction: inspect component/total fraction and cosine. Final value uses terminal affinity/quality and matched controls.
contract.registered_active_forces: pointwise/pair/band/pocket/orientation/selection operator as program says; typed/charge only when positive weights. Detached element assignment is not direct type force. A polar-selected support with pointwise reward is still geometry-only.
contract.response_routing: Response routing uses sparse per-mode coordinate VJPs of this surrogate, from the same generator forward. Gap-normalized local controllability is NOT future affinity. Nearest geometry, surrogate controllability and final outcome are separate hypotheses. Two probe times are configurable fractions of the control window; no extra generator/affinity forwards.
contract.router: One active local mode per seed, state compatibility is detached, no full-cloud union.
contract.surrogate_units: Geometry distance losses and sigma-scaled type/charge fields have A^2 units. Orientation and standardized feature log-ratios are dimensionless; relative chemical coefficients then carry compensating A^-2 units. These are optimization surrogates, not physical energies. Kernel mass is dimensionless; signed displacement components are A.
contract.teacher_roles: Terminal source roles are not early-state actual identities.
